item_name: Rothco Enhanced Universal Flashlight Holder - Black
item_short_desc: Easily add a flashlight onto your duty belt with our Enhanced Universal Flashlight Holder.
description: Easily add a flashlight onto your duty belt with our Enhanced Universal Flashlight Holder. Its thick polyester composition is durable and water-resistant for a flashlight holder that will be reliable in the field for years at a time. This flashlight holder is incredibly easy-to-install thanks to its intuitive slide-on design. It fits comfortably onto belts up to 2.25 inches wide and accommodates flashlights up to 1 inch in diameter, making it an ideal addition to just about any duty belt. With our dependable snap-on closure, you can effortlessly access your flashlight at a moment’s notice no matter the situation.
